lines.text: Silly online content that feels empty.
Too many videos give me brain rot.

data.mean: Silly online content that feels empty.
data.define: Jokingly used for low-quality videos you scroll too much.

example.text: Too many videos give me brain rot.

data.l1_hook: Tiga jam video konyol! brain rot
data.l1_ex: Terlalu banyak video membuat saya "brain rot".
